statement: For every odd n at least 3, the genus-n curve v^2=w^(2n+1)-w with its two cusps removed is a degree-2n geometric dihedral cover of U; at 2 its actual pointed stable model is a rational centre with n supersingular elliptic tails. Its full geometric pro-prime fixed subgroup is selected cusp inertia for every coefficient prime, every cusp packet, and every indicated open derived subgroup. A general two-branch tame Kummer construction over colliding torsion cusps is proved as well.
